issues.problem: A hidden part still moves the mass and balance shown. It does not change who owns an overlap (round 4 closed that); it changes how another hidden part's overlap is measured. A cleaned part above another cleaned part joins that part's higher set H. That switches the job from exact clipping to sampling (a round part, or more than MAX_EXACT higher parts), grows the sampled box, and adds work to the cleaned parts' shared share of N_OVERLAP_WORK (cells × (1+#H)), which coarsens every cleaned job. G never moves. Round 4's new text says the opposite: §4.5 'steers nothing else ... so no hidden part moves the mass or the balance but by what it owns'; §4.4 'a hidden part steers none of the physics a player is shown (the mass and the balance but by what it owns ...)'; §5.6 'the physics a hidden part leaves to the bit'. Constructed case (work/hsteer2.luau, out/hsteer2_all.txt): F2 + boxedF2's walls 11-16 + Guard fillers 17 (0.258×0.258×0.19 at z −0.034) and 18 (the same at z 0.045, 0.01 into wall 16). S1: add a Blade Dust Ball d 0.015 inside wall 16 on 18's poke; it owns 7.96e-8. Mass 1.291184278 → 1.292363587 (+1.1793e-3 kg), balance 0.382958920 → 0.385027643 (+2.0687e-3). S2: add two Blade Block specks there, which own exactly 0: +1.1787e-3. S3: add a Pommel filler 21 under 13/17/18, then Ctrl+D 17 in place. The copy owns 0, but 21's owned volume goes 4e-5 → 6e-17: mass −3.148e-4, balance −5.53e-4. S4: cleaned share at 39,946 of 40,000; a Dust Ball d 0.05 buried in F2's guard at (0.3, 1.45, 0), owning 2.95e-6, gives mass +2.5843e-3, balance +4.4975e-3. S5: Ctrl+D in place of the visible wall 16 gives +2.5611e-3, balance +4.5044e-3. f7ac37d and r3 give the same figures. Plausible set (work/ctrld.luau: every part again in place, designs with a cleaned part): `wrapRings|C09|n4 extra0.02 gap0.0010` with Ctrl+D of its guard #7 (or #21/#22) goes mass 0.659536347 → 0.665177664 (+5.64e-3 kg, +0.86 %), balance 0.155227690 → 0.149296747. The cause (work/hjob.luau): its fully covered Enclosed core #3 gains the copy in H (8 → 9); the cleaned spacing coarsens; the clamped estimate 0.0159043 becomes 0.0151875. f7ac37d does not move on this design (0.660192434 both ways), so it is a per-design regression on Ctrl+D. Every 5th plausible design from #1: 12,217 copies; the tree moves 5 of them (2 designs; also n3 +1.03e-3), plus 35 in the last bits. From #3: 6 (wedgeInGuard CornerWedge +5.2e-4). f7ac37d moves 14 (7 pommelInBlock|C09 designs, down to −8.85e-4) plus 73 in the last bits. The class is M2's, but it is exactly round 3's trigger (a Ctrl+D copy) and round 4's text denies it.

summary:
Reviewer V1, round 4: the rule round 4 built holds, but two majors stand, both in what the SPEC claims; pass = false. The rule: a cleaned part goes after the kept ones, by its material, then by its place from the kept parts' centre. No hidden part, id, Y/Z/X move or turn changes which of two hidden parts owns their overlap. This was checked on round 3's probes, 443 moves of tied hidden-part designs, ids/ulp twins and 28 mutants. Mirrors, ids and corpora read exactly as round 3. Cost is noise, determinism and no-mutation hold, there is no NaN, and §4.1 holds.

Major A: hidden parts still move the mass and balance shown (G never) by changing how another hidden part's overlap is measured. They join its higher set, which switches exact clipping to sampling or past MAX_EXACT, grows the box, and draws on the cleaned parts' shared budget. Round 4's new §4.5/§4.4 text says the opposite. Examples: a speck owning nothing moves the mass +1.18e-3 kg; a Dust Ball anywhere tips the budget, +2.58e-3; a Ctrl+D copy in place moves a plausible wrapRings design by +5.64e-3 kg (0.86 %), which f7ac37d does not. f7ac37d has its own such designs, so the class is M2's. Fix tried: leave exact copies out of the higher set (about 8 lines). It closes every Ctrl+D case, with zero corpus change, no golden moved and no cost. Add a pin and text for the remaining speck/budget class (out/fix_dedupe_text.diff).

Major B: §4.3's 'no turn a mirror image rewrites decides' and §4.4's and README's 'only' are false. Parts at one place go by their turn: crossed Dust Cylinders move the Z image's mass by 1.4e-5 to 2.1e-5 kg (as on f7ac37d). Text fix tried.

Minor: 10 behaviour-changing mutants survive the suite, two of which bring back round 3's same-material hidden steer; I wrote and tried a pin for each (out/pins_round4.diff). The --quick gate was not checked quiet.
